title: "Christopher Tong's Applied Statistics Repository"

Welcome to my repository for applied statistics.  I've gathered here some resources and commentary that others might find of value.  See the above menu for guided links to the main content.

The site's content reflects my background and experience as a former biostatistician (nonclinical, preclinical, and clinical) with interests in machine learning, laboratory quality assurance, and the physical and engineering sciences.




### This site's policy on large language models

No artificial intelligence was used in creating the content found on this site.  I do not use large language models to find or interpret literature, nor to support my own research, coding, and writing.
